svg.title: CHRONA — Material Symbols Rounded Icon System
svg.desc: 24dp grid, 1.8dp rounded stroke weight, active/inactive variants.

g.text: 24×24dp optical grid · 1.8dp stroke weight · Round caps & joins · Standardized across all 5 destinations
A. Core Application & Navigation Iconography (20 Glyphs)
• Stroke Weight: 1.8dp inactive / 2.0dp active state · Linecap: round · Linejoin: round · Optical live area: 20×20dp inside 24×24dp bounding box.
• Touch Target: Standalone icon buttons always sit inside a 48×48dp circular hit container with contentDescription for TalkBack accessibility.
